name: Simple Letter

angles.text: Llane Beshere serves as the resident warrior trainer at Northshire Abbey, making this simple letter the initial summons to martial discipline for newly arrived fighters.
Northshire Abbey is the cradle of human adventurers setting forth into Elwynn Forest, where local recruits receive their opening guidance.
Even within the relative sanctuary protected by the Silver Hand, fresh recruits are immediately called upon to aid the troubled citizens of the Alliance.

faq.answer: The Simple Letter is an introductory missive handed to warriors in Northshire Valley once they return from the kobold camps. It directs them to introduce themselves to the local warrior trainer, Llane Beshere, to begin their formal martial training.

Llane Beshere is the warrior trainer stationed in Northshire Abbey. He instructs novice warriors in combat techniques, welcoming recruits who arrive in the valley bearing orders or recommendations to seek him out.

aliases: where to turn in simple letter
faq.answer: The letter is brought directly to Llane Beshere, who can be found in Northshire Abbey within Northshire Valley, surrounded by the sheltered grounds protected by the holy order.
faq.q: Where do I deliver the Simple Letter?

aliases: what are paladins doing in northshire
faq.answer: The Knights of the Silver Hand help guard Northshire Valley, keeping the abbey and its immediate perimeter relatively secure so that recruits, farmers, and clergy can go about their duties despite growing local tensions.
faq.q: What role do the Knights of the Silver Hand play in Northshire?

aliases: why does beshere want me to help citizens
faq.answer: While the abbey itself remains fairly defended, local residents face constant encroachments and shortages. Beshere advises new arrivals to explore the surrounding land and lend their martial strength to those in need.
faq.q: Why are the local citizens in need of assistance?

aliases: when should i return to llane beshere
faq.answer: Llane Beshere remains available at the abbey day and night, ready to instruct warriors as they gain combat experience and require advanced martial skills.
faq.q: When should I return to Llane Beshere after delivering the letter?

sections.body: The Simple Letter serves as an initial introduction for aspiring warriors arriving in Northshire Valley. Directed to Llane Beshere, the resident warrior trainer at Northshire Abbey, the letter prompts newly arrived fighters to make contact with their instructor, familiarize themselves with their surroundings, and prepare for the demands of martial life.
sections.title: A Call to Arms

sections.body: Although Northshire Abbey enjoys protection under the watchful presence of the Knights of the Silver Hand, the peaceful facade of the valley belies deeper trouble. As Beshere notes upon receiving the letter, the surrounding residents face numerous plights that require able-bodied protectors, urging fresh recruits to master their weapons and step forward in defense of the realm.
sections.title: Securing the Valley

summary: The Simple Letter is an introductory directive that guides novice warriors to trainer Llane Beshere at Northshire Abbey. It marks the beginning of their formal martial instruction and urges them to assist the troubled citizens of the valley.
